title_zh: 把技术职业愿望化成首个练习目标

scenario.label_zh: 把职业愿望拆成可检查的学习目标
scenario.goal_zh: 说明长远职业愿望，并约定用一份可独立复现的入门项目作为首个学习检查点

context_zh: 成人学习者与课程导师讨论学习方向，不作就业保证。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: My long-term aspiration is to design accessible websites, but I don't know where to start.

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: What level of skill do you hope to attain by the end of this introductory course?

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: I aspire to work professionally one day. For now, I'd like to build a simple page without copying every step.

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: Then let's use one small project as a benchmark: a page you can explain and rebuild on your own.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: That sounds manageable. I'll make a one-page guide to our local walking group.

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: Bring it to our final tutorial. We'll look at what you can do independently and choose the next step from there.
